commitResults.messageBody:
Deadlines and events currently store temporal values as arbitrary strings, which prevents validation, formatting, and date-based queries.
This commit adds the record TaskDate to represent a serialisable Date and Time for our app.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add assertions for task list invariants
commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList assumes that callers provide valid tasks, keywords, and indexes.

Assertions make these assumptions explicit during development while
preserving the existing exception behavior when assertions are disabled.

commitResults.messageTitle: Centralize task completion updates
commitResults.messageBody:
MarkCommand and UnmarkCommand duplicate the task update and
confirmation flow.

Centralizing that flow in Command keeps both commands consistent and
rejects unsupported update command types explicitly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use streams when loading stored tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Storage loads every non-blank line from the task file and converts it
into a task or corrupted-task record.

Use a stream pipeline for filtering, parsing, and collecting those
records while preserving their order and existing malformed-record
handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add session-based undo
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot reverse task changes after issuing a command, which makes
correcting accidental additions, deletions, and completion changes
inconvenient.

Add a session undo history and an undo command for task-list mutations.
Store inverse actions so task order and previous completion states are
restored without changing the persistent storage format.

Keep undo history in memory because it is scoped to one application session,
and restore a failed undo when saving the restored state is unsuccessful.

commitResults.messageTitle: Give DUDE a consistent friendly personality
commitResults.messageBody:
The command-line and GUI-facing messages currently use a mixture of neutral and
friendly wording, so DUDE does not yet have a consistent personality.

Refresh the shared UI messages with a clear, supportive task-buddy voice and
synchronize the recorded CLI transcripts with the new observable output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle duplicate tasks through shared UI resolution
commitResults.messageBody:
Task creation previously accepted duplicate descriptions without giving users a
way to decide whether to keep, replace, or cancel the new task. Command parsing
also allowed arguments for commands that do not accept them.

Add a shared duplicate conflict model and resolution handler, with console and
JavaFX implementations. Preserve completion state and undo support when editing,
normalize duplicate comparisons, validate command delimiters and no-argument
commands, and expose storage paths for reliable error-handling tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand tests for parsing duplicates and storage
commitResults.messageBody:
The new duplicate-resolution and input-validation paths need coverage beyond
the existing undo and date tests, especially for interface-independent behaviour
and persistence edge cases.

Add parser tests for blank and unexpected arguments, normalized duplicate and
replacement tests for TaskList, and temporary-directory storage tests covering
escaped task round trips and corrupted records.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JavaFX GUI and harden command handling
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce the JavaFX conversation window, preserve original search indexes, and expand regression coverage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor commands and strengthen checks
commitResults.messageBody:
Command classes and supporting responsibilities are spread across many packages,
making the design harder to review and maintain.

The project also lacks deterministic checks for Java conventions and a reliable
path to produce the required single fat JAR.

Organize commands and infrastructure into cohesive packages. Split storage, UI,
task, and exception code into focused classes. Strengthen Checkstyle and Gradle
checks, expand regression coverage, and add a tag-triggered workflow for one
validated Shadow JAR release.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete DUDE user guide and GUI refinements
commitResults.messageBody: Document every supported command with runnable examples and full-window screenshots for the product website. Improve GUI error guidance and wrap event date ranges across two lines so task details remain readable without horizontal scrolling.

commitResults.messageTitle: Polish command palette and user guide setup
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep the matching command usage visible while users enter command arguments so the GUI continues to provide a reference after the command word.

Document release-first setup, source build instructions, repository links, and guide contents. Add regression coverage for the command palette behavior and record it in the UI test plan.
